title: Tree Clones: The Largest Living Thing on Earth
grammar: Defining relative clauses: who, which, that, where

questions.sentence: The largest living thing in the world is a tree _____ is called Pando.

questions.question: Which relative pronoun do we use for things?
options: which / that
who
where
when
questions.explain: Use who for people, which/that for things.

questions.sentence: Pando is a quaking aspen tree _____ reproduces differently.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Pando is a tree that reproduces differently.
Pando is a tree who reproduces differently.
Pando is a tree where reproduces differently.
Pando is a tree when reproduces differently.

questions.sentence: There are some mycologists _____ might claim that a fungal mat is the largest living thing.

questions.question: Which relative pronoun do we use for people?
options: who
which
where
that

questions.sentence: The trees _____ make up Pando cover 106 acres.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: The trees that make up Pando cover 106 acres.
The trees who make up Pando cover 106 acres.
The trees where make up Pando cover 106 acres.
The trees when make up Pando cover 106 acres.

questions.sentence: Fish Lake National Forest is the place _____ Pando lives.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: This is the forest where Pando lives.
This is the forest which Pando lives.
This is the forest who Pando lives.
This is the forest when Pando lives.

questions.sentence: Pando has a root system _____ shoots up new trees.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: The roots that shoot up create new trees.
The roots who shoot up create new trees.
The roots where shoot up create new trees.
The roots when shoot up create new trees.

questions.sentence: Pando is dying. Forest rangers _____ work here are trying to save him.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: The rangers who work here are trying to save Pando.
The rangers which work here are trying to save Pando.
The rangers where work here are trying to save Pando.
The rangers when work here are trying to save Pando.

questions.correct: The largest living thing is a tree called Pando.

a type of tree with leaves that shake
a living thing copied from another
all the roots of a plant
